description: Enhanced boundary coverage for runtime value classification: zero/one/large byteLength buffers, typed arrays and data views, the false boolean, negative/zero/fractional/large numbers, the empty string, whitespace and unicode strings, and alternate symbol payloads. Each input still reports exactly its matching category (plus the generic object category for non-null object-like values).
